text: {"lessons":["My account value has moved up and down, so I should judge progress over time rather than react to one month’s return.","Selling Stocks A and C at large losses was a consequential choice; I should revisit my reasons and risk limits before selling, not let a loss alone dictate the decision.","I added to Stocks B, D, and E, so I should check that each position still fits a diversified plan and avoid buying more just because a price fell."]}
